cases.case_label: SVA_F (~1.7 kb) in exon 13 of BBS1
cases.mechanism_detail: A paternally inherited ~1.7-kb SVA (SVA_F-like) in BBS1 exon 13, in trans with p.Met390Arg; the SVA-containing allele is expressed in patient LCLs and predicted to encode BBS1 up to residue 406 followed by 46 SVA-derived residues and a stop codon.
cases.quote: these results showed that BBS1 protein is translated up to AA residue 406, followed by insertion of 46 new AA residues (corresponding to the SVA) before reaching stop codon
